# files_certificate (Resource)

A Certificate is a way to store your custom SSL certificate for your Files.com site.
Files.com is also capable of registering SSL certificates itself, so this is only required if you have specific security requirements to use your own certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "files_certificate" "example_certificate" {
  name                      = "Name"
  certificate_domain        = "domain.com"
  certificate_extra_domains = ["www.domain.com"]
  key_type                  = "RSA-4096"
  certificate               = "[certificate]"
  intermediates             = "[certificates]"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Descriptive name of certificate

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `certificate` (String) Full text of SSL certificate
- `certificate_city_or_locale` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) City or locale.
- `certificate_company_name` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Company name.
- `certificate_country` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Country.
- `certificate_domain` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Domain for certificate.
- `certificate_email_address` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Email address for the certificate owner.
- `certificate_extra_domains` (List of String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Additional domains for the certificate CSR.
- `certificate_state_or_province` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) State or province.
- `csr_ou1` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Department name or organization unit 1
- `csr_ou2` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Department name or organization unit 2
- `csr_ou3` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Department name or organization unit 3
- `intermediates` (String) Intermediate certificates
- `key_type` (String) Type of key
- `password` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Certificate password.
- `private_key` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Certificate private key.

### Read-Only

- `brick_managed` (Boolean) Is this certificate automatically managed and renewed by Files.com?
- `created_at` (String) Certificate created at
- `custom_domain_id` (Number) Custom Domain that owns this certificate, including while the certificate is inactive.
- `display_status` (String) Certificate status. (One of `Request Generated`, `New`, `Active`, `Active/Expired`, `Expired`, or `Available`)
- `domains` (List of String) Domains on this certificate other than files.com domains
- `expires_at` (String) Certificate expiration date/time
- `id` (Number) Certificate ID
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) A list of IP addresses associated with this SSL Certificate
- `issuer` (String) X509 issuer
- `request` (String) Certificate signing request text
- `status` (String) Certificate status (Request Generated, New, Active, Active/Expired, Expired, or Available)
- `subject` (String) X509 Subject name

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Certificates can be imported by specifying the id.
terraform import files_certificate.example_certificate 1
```
